result.reason: The clause properly provides up to six months of reasonable transition assistance at then-current rates, satisfying that part of the preferred position. However, the operative language does not itself require return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days or certification of deletion thereafter. The references to Sections 11.2 and 11.3 cannot establish compliance because their terms are not provided, and the margin comment cannot cure missing operative requirements. Otherwise, the revision is targeted and professionally drafted.
